evidence_items.publisher: Bloomberg, republished by The Business Times
evidence_items.explanation: This is a contemporaneous executive attribution of reduced engineering hiring to AI, rather than merely a future forecast. It supplies no entry-level breakdown or independently verified comparison addressing other causes.

The report documents declining new-graduate hiring but discusses financing conditions and previous overhiring alongside AI. Its descriptive data do not isolate an AI effect on entry-level software engineering.

evidence_items.publisher: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization; Oxford repository
evidence_items.locator: Introduction; see also section 3.2.2 and Table 2
evidence_items.explanation: The study uses comparisons over time and between exposure groups to examine freelance demand, including a novice-worker decline in a broad category containing programming skills. It does not separately establish lost entry-level software engineering positions; employer-requested experience is also not the actual experience of hired workers.
